description: The Operation system of the engineering model (PADRAO-DEV F7d, D-320, D-321): the data stores and the data subject requests. Reader: scripts/lib/model.py.

operation.restore_max_days.description: Longest a data store's last verified restore may lie in the past for it to count as protected (a quarterly restore drill); past it the store is unverified. A ceiling: raising it loosens the Operation system.
